verdict.rationale: Gladia's own docs show transcript data can be exported in open formats: SRT/VTT caption export, and the CLI emits plain text, JSON, SRT or VTT in machine-readable form. Nothing shows a bulk export of all account data or a documented offboarding path. Missing for 10: bulk export of all stored account data (transcripts, history, settings), documented account deletion/offboarding process, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export subtitles (SRT/VTT): Generate caption files directly from transcripts
Flexible output: plain text, JSON, SRT, or VTT to stdout
Pipe-friendly: machine-readable output for scripts and CI
